data.gender_notes: Celisse is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Celisse refers to the goddess Selene, goddess of the Moon. Her name comes from the Greek word 'selene', meaning 'shining, luminous'. Celisse symbolizes the illumination and protection bestowed by the Moon. The name Celisse carries the meaning “Moonlight, Celestial Light” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Celisse usually hope their child will grow to embody moonlight, celestial light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name imbued with celestial light and divine guidance.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Celisse total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_greek.name: Κελισσέ
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο όνομα Κελισσέ προέρχεται από το ελληνικό κόσμημα. Ο όρος στέμμα ενσαρκώνει την ιδιοκτησία και την εξουσία. Η Κελισσέ είναι η στέμμα της αρετής. Ο όρος σωτηρία αναφέρεται στην απελευθέρωση από την παγωνιά και την πείνα. Η Κελισσέ είναι η σωτήρας. Ο όρος κεχωρισμός αναφέρεται στην απομόνωση των ανθρώπων. Η Κελισσέ είναι η κεχωριστή. Ο όρος στέμμα ενσαρκώνει την εξουσία και την ιδιοκτησία, και η Κελισσέ είναι η στέμμα της αρετής.

in_latin.name: Celisse
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Celisse a vocabulo Graeco deductum est. Vocabulum στέμμα indicat dominium et potentiam. Celisse est στέμμα virtutis. Vocabulum σωτηρία referre potest ad liberationem ab frigore et fame. Celisse est σωτήρας. Vocabulum κεχωρισμός referre potest ad separationem hominum. Celisse est κεχωριστή. Vocabulum στέμμα indicat dominium et potentiam, et Celisse est στέμμα virtutis.

in_english.name: Celisse
in_english.meaning: beautiful, saved, solitary, chaste, heavenly beauty
in_english.long_meaning: The name Celisse is derived from the Greek word στέμμα, which means crown, and indicates dominance and power. Celisse is the crown of virtue. The word salvation refers to freedom from cold and hunger. Celisse is the savior. The word solitude refers to the separation of humans. Celisse is the solitary. The name Celisse is associated with heavenliness and beauty. It is a popular name in Christian cultures, symbolizing the virtues of chastity and beauty. In the early Christian church, Celisse was a name given to females who demonstrated exceptional virtues and beauty.

data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Celisse lies in its meaning—shining, luminous. It symbolizes the inner light and illumination that each individual carries within themselves. The name Celisse can serve as a reminder to seek strength, comfort, and guidance from the divine power of the Moon and the inner light of one's own soul. It can also encourage individuals to share their light with the world and inspire others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Celisse, meaning "heavenly gift," embodies the spiritual journey of a soul touched by divine grace. It symbolizes the gift of God's love and the inner transformation that comes from embracing faith.
